title: Intake, leads and consultations
summary: Captures prospects from web forms, email and phone notes into one lead inbox, where the agent triages each one (practice area, urgency, limitation-period risk, dedupe, pre-conflict screen). Leads then move through a pipeline to a booked consultation and a decision. A lawyer accepts or declines every lead and approves every retain, decline or refer outcome before the prospect becomes a client.

screens.name: Public intake form
screens.purpose: Lets a prospective client tell the firm about their problem without creating an account.
screens.layout: Single column on the firm's brand. Header shows the firm name and a short notice that the firm does not act for the prospect yet. Below sit form steps (about you, the other side, what happened, key dates, documents) and an optional chat-style helper panel. The footer holds the consent checkbox and submit button.

fields.name: full_name
fields.note: Legal name, plus optional preferred name

fields.name: email
fields.note: Verified by a one-time link before booking

fields.name: phone
fields.note: E.164 format, with a 'may we leave a voicemail' checkbox

fields.name: preferred_contact
fields.note: email | phone | text

fields.name: matter_type_hint
fields.note: Firm's practice areas plus 'not sure'. The agent reclassifies it anyway

fields.name: other_parties
fields.note: Names of the other side, their lawyers, insurers and employers. Needed for the conflict screen

fields.name: story
fields.note: Free text. The help text asks for facts only, not documents marked privileged

fields.name: key_date
fields.note: 'When did this happen or when did you find out?' Drives the limitation-period flag

fields.name: deadline_known
fields.note: Any court date, notice or letter with a deadline

fields.name: attachments
fields.note: PDF or images, 25 MB total, virus scanned, held in quarantine until the lead is accepted

fields.name: referral_source
fields.note: search | referral | LSO Referral Service | past client | social | other

fields.name: consent_contact
fields.note: Consent to be contacted about this inquiry

fields.name: consent_marketing
fields.note: Separate opt-in, never pre-ticked (CASL)

fields.name: ack_no_relationship
fields.note: Prospect acknowledges that no lawyer-client relationship exists yet

actions.name: Submit inquiry
actions.note: Creates a Lead with status 'new' and sends an auto-acknowledgement with no advice in it

actions.name: Guided chat intake
actions.note: Optional conversational mode. It asks follow-up questions, never gives legal advice, and writes its answers back into the same fields

actions.name: Self-book consultation
actions.note: Shown only if the form's settings allow it and the email is verified. Slot holds are tentative until G1

screens.agent: In chat mode, asks clarifying questions about dates, parties and the location of the events. Refuses advice requests with a fixed safe message. Detects an emergency (safety risk, a court date within 7 days) and shows the firm's urgent phone number. Runs no conflict search in front of the prospect.
edge: Spam and bot submissions: captcha, honeypot field and per-IP rate limit
Prospect pastes very long privileged documents into the story field: soft cap with a prompt to attach instead
Prospect is the opposing party of an existing client: the form still accepts it, the screen flags it later and nothing is revealed to the prospect
Duplicate submission within 24h: merged into the existing lead
Minor or person under disability: the form asks whether a guardian or litigation guardian is involved
French-language request: form offered in FR (French Language Services consideration) (verify whether required for a private firm)
screens.reg: RPC 3.3 confidentiality applies to information from prospective clients. Information received can create a conflict even if the firm never acts (RPC 3.4 commentary) (verify exact rule ref). Disclaimer text must not be misleading (RPC 4.2 marketing). Contact consent and a separate marketing opt-in are needed for CASL. PIPEDA consent and purpose statement apply. Data stored in Canada.

rows: Terminated without notice after 6 years, told 'restructuring'

screens.name: Intake form builder
screens.purpose: Lets the firm build and publish intake forms for each practice area.
screens.layout: Left: list of forms with publish status. Centre: field canvas with drag-to-order and a library of standard fields. Right: settings for the form (practice area, routing, auto-ack template, self-booking, languages) and a live preview.

fields.name: slug
fields.note: Unique within the firm

fields.name: practice_area
fields.note: Default classification hint

fields.name: fields
fields.note: Standard fields (parties, key date, consent) are locked on and cannot be removed

fields.name: route_to
fields.note: Default reviewing lawyer or queue

fields.name: auto_ack_template
fields.note: Must pass a check that it contains no advice

fields.name: consult_fee
fields.note: If set, it is collected at booking (see Consultation booking)

fields.name: embed_code
fields.note: Read-only iframe or script snippet

fields.name: question_types
fields.note: short text, long text, single choice, multi choice, dropdown, date, yes/no, file, money, address, phone

fields.name: follow_ups
fields.note: Extra questions shown after a given answer; nesting allowed one level

fields.name: field_mapping
fields.note: Each answer maps to a contact, lead or matter field; type must match

fields.name: languages
fields.note: en, fr; all text translated, not only built-in labels

fields.name: defaults
fields.note: Stage, assignee and sender used for submissions

actions.name: Draft form from description
actions.note: For example, 'a form for slip-and-fall cases'. The agent proposes fields and questions

actions.name: Publish
actions.note: A lawyer or admin approves the public text: disclaimer, consent wording and the auto-ack message

actions.name: Unpublish / archive
actions.note: Old submissions stay linked

screens.agent: Drafts forms and questions for a practice area. Lints the disclaimers, consent wording and auto-ack text for advice, guarantees of results or misleading claims.
screens.gate: Publishing a form or changing its public wording needs approval from a lawyer or admin.
edge: Removing a field that past leads used: the field is hidden, not deleted
Self-booking is turned on but no lawyer has availability: block publishing
Consult fee is set but no payment account is connected: block publishing
Acknowledgement checkbox needed as a hard requirement: use a required yes/no, not an optional checkbox
screens.reg: Marketing and advertising content must be accurate and must not promise results (RPC 4.2-1) (verify). The consent wording must meet PIPEDA and CASL.

screens.name: Lead inbox
screens.purpose: Gives one triaged queue of every new inquiry from forms, email, phone notes and referrals.
screens.layout: Top bar: filters (source, practice area, urgency, risk flag, assignee, status) and search. Main area: list sorted by urgency, then time-to-limitation, then age. Right: a preview pane with the agent summary and quick actions.

fields.name: source
fields.note: web form | email | phone note | referral | manual

fields.name: practice_area
fields.note: Classified by the agent, with a confidence score

fields.name: urgency
fields.note: critical | high | normal | low

fields.name: limitation_flag
fields.note: none | watch | at risk | possibly expired | unknown

fields.name: pre_conflict
fields.note: clear | possible hit | hit. Only internal users with conflict permission see the details

fields.name: sla_due
fields.note: First-response target set by urgency

fields.name: triage_outcome
fields.note: new | for_review | ignored. for_review holds referrals from lawyers, third-party lead notices and unclear senders; no auto-reply is sent for these.

fields.name: fit
fields.note: good | possible | poor | tbd (agent), with reasons

fields.name: mobile_layout
fields.note: At phone width the list sorts by consults today or tomorrow, then good fit

actions.name: Assign / reassign
actions.note: The agent proposes an assignee by practice area and load

actions.name: Merge duplicates
actions.note: The agent proposes merges. A human confirms

actions.name: Mark spam
actions.note: Deleted after 30 days. The agent can auto-mark obvious bot submissions, and they stay reviewable

actions.name: Bulk decline
actions.note: Each declined lead still gets its own non-engagement letter

actions.name: Show ignored / restore
actions.note: Ignored leads are never deleted; restore puts them back in New

actions.name: Quick accept: contact only
actions.note: Creates a contact without a matter, still needs G1 note

screens.agent: Triages each arrival within a minute. It classifies practice area and sub-type, scores urgency, computes the limitation flag from the key dates, runs the pre-conflict name screen, dedupes against existing leads and contacts, writes a 3-line summary, and proposes an assignee and the next step.
screens.gate: none (triage is advisory. The accept/decline decision happens on Lead detail, G1)
states: triage failed (shows a retry and the raw submission)
edge: The agent cannot classify the lead: practice area set to 'unclassified', which forces human review
Key date missing: limitation flag 'unknown', ranked above 'none'
The same person sends a phone note and a web form: proposed merge
A lead outside the firm's practice areas: suggest a referral, and it still needs G1 to decline
SLA breach: escalate to the responsible lawyer and add it to the daily digest
Lead arrives from an external source with a bad or rotated key: rejected and logged, admin alerted
screens.reg: Conflict-hit details are restricted to authorized roles. A lead's information stays confidential even after it is declined (RPC 3.3). Audit log of who viewed what.

screens.name: Phone note and email capture
screens.purpose: Turns a phone call or a forwarded email into a structured lead.
screens.layout: Left: raw input (call notes typed live, a transcript upload, or the email thread from the intake mailbox). Right: the structured lead the agent extracts, with each field marked by its source span.

fields.name: raw_input
fields.note: Notes, a transcript, or the email body and attachments

fields.name: ok_to_leave_message
fields.note: Matters for family violence and employment matters

fields.name: extracted_fields
fields.note: Same schema as the public form

fields.name: taken_by
fields.note: Staff member

actions.name: Extract lead
actions.note: Fills the fields and marks low-confidence values

actions.name: Save as lead
actions.note: Staff confirm the extracted fields

actions.name: Attach to existing lead
actions.note: For follow-up calls or emails

screens.agent: Watches the intake mailbox (a firm address) and builds draft leads from new threads. Extracts parties, dates, location and the ask, and runs the same triage as web leads. A call transcript is parsed only if the caller consented to recording.
edge: Email is from an existing client about an open matter: route it to that matter, not the lead inbox
Email from the opposing counsel or party of a current matter: do not create a lead, alert the responsible lawyer
Call recorded without consent: the transcript upload is blocked and only staff notes are kept
Several prospects in one email, such as spouses: propose split leads with a joint-retainer note
screens.reg: Recording calls needs notice or consent (verify the applicable federal or provincial rule for one-party consent versus PIPEDA notice). Joint retainers need specific disclosure (RPC 3.4-5) (verify).

screens.name: Lead detail
screens.purpose: The single page where a lead is reviewed, worked and accepted or declined.
screens.layout: Header: name, stage, urgency and limitation chips, assignee, and Accept/Decline/Refer buttons. Left: the agent's triage card (summary, classification, limitation analysis, pre-conflict result, missing info). Centre tabs: Submission, Timeline (all contacts, emails and calls), Documents (quarantined), Notes. Right: next step, tasks and the consultation panel.

fields.name: contact
fields.note: A prospect Contact, not yet a Client

fields.name: parties
fields.note: Role: prospect, adverse, related, insurer, opposing counsel

fields.name: practice_area
fields.note: The human can override the agent

fields.name: facts_summary
fields.note: Agent draft that staff can edit

fields.name: key_dates
fields.note: Incident, discovery, termination, death, notice received

fields.name: limitation_analysis
fields.note: {regime, trigger date, expiry estimate, basis, confidence}. Advisory only, and the lawyer confirms it

fields.name: pre_conflict_result
fields.note: Links to the full conflict check (conflicts area) once the lead is accepted

fields.name: estimated_value
fields.note: For pipeline metrics

fields.name: stage
fields.note: See CRM pipeline

fields.name: decision
fields.note: accepted | declined | referred | pending

fields.name: decision_reason
fields.note: Required on decline: conflict, outside practice, capacity, no merit, other

fields.name: score
fields.note: With score version and the factors behind it

fields.name: timeline
fields.note: Calls, emails, SMS, form events, bookings; automated reminders included

fields.name: fit
fields.note: good | possible | poor | tbd

fields.name: fit_reasons
fields.note: Each reason cites the message or form answer it came from; opens with source highlight

fields.name: payment_status
fields.note: none | requested | paid to trust | refunded

actions.name: Accept lead (G1)
actions.note: Lawyer only. Opens the formal conflict check and allows a consult to be booked

actions.name: Decline lead (G1)
actions.note: Lawyer approves the drafted non-engagement letter, which is then sent

actions.name: Refer out
actions.note: Lawyer picks a referral firm, and the agent drafts the referral note. Referral fee rules are checked

actions.name: Request missing info
actions.note: Sends a templated, advice-free question to the prospect (for example 'what date were you terminated?')

actions.name: Override classification / limitation
actions.note: Logged with the reason

actions.name: Text the lead
actions.note: Only if SMS consent recorded

actions.name: Take over from agent
actions.note: Stops all agent screening and sequences for this lead permanently; logged

actions.name: Request retainer or consult payment
actions.note: Payment link through the trust payment provider. Money for future services is deposited to trust as client money, never as earned. A refund needs G-fee.

actions.name: Reply to SMS
actions.note: SMS is two-way: inbound replies attach to the timeline; STOP/ARRET opts out on all channels

screens.agent: Keeps the triage card current as new info arrives. Drafts the follow-up questions, the non-engagement letter and the referral note. Recomputes the limitation flag whenever a date changes. Never sends anything that could read as advice without the gate.
screens.gate: G1: a lawyer accepts, declines or refers the lead. On decline or refer, the lawyer approves the exact non-engagement or referral letter text.
edge: Pre-conflict 'hit': Accept is disabled until the conflict lead reviews it. Staff can still decline, and the decline letter reveals nothing about the conflict
Limitation 'possibly expired': show a banner, and the decline letter must state that a limitation period may apply and urge prompt independent advice
Prospect stops responding: the agent schedules follow-ups and proposes 'closed - no response' after N attempts, which still needs G1 with a letter
Prospect asks for advice by email before acceptance: the agent drafts a holding reply. A lawyer must approve anything substantive
Lead reopened after a decline: a new G1 is required
Lead pays a retainer then is declined at G1: refund goes through G-fee; the trust record stays
screens.reg: Non-engagement (declining) letters are a LawPRO risk-management recommendation, and they should mention any limitation-period risk (verify LawPRO guidance). RPC 3.3 confidentiality applies, and information received may disqualify the firm from acting against the prospect (RPC 3.4) (verify). Referral fees are allowed only under RPC 3.6-6.1 conditions (written agreement, client consent, not to non-licensees) (verify). Limitations Act, 2002 (Ontario): basic 2 years from discovery, ultimate 15 years. Some claims have shorter notice periods.

rows: Tsion Haile, 6-yr warehouse supervisor at Northgate Logistics, terminated 2026-08-29 without cause. Offered 2 weeks pay. Wants advice on severance.
Basic 2-yr period from 2026-08-29 -> est. 2028-08-29. ESA complaint route also possible (verify window). Flag: watch
Clear: no match for Northgate Logistics Inc. or Brian Ostrowski
Written termination letter; employment contract; age and role

screens.name: Intake pipeline board
screens.purpose: Shows every open lead by stage so nothing stalls between inquiry and retainer.
screens.layout: A board with one column per stage, each column showing a count and value total. Cards show the name, area, days in stage, the next follow-up and the limitation chip. The top has a switcher for pipeline (per practice area), filters, and a stuck-leads toggle.

fields.name: stage
fields.note: Default: New -> Triaged -> Accepted (G1) -> Conflict cleared (G2) -> Consult booked -> Consult held -> Retain decided (G3) -> Engagement sent -> Converted. Lost and Declined are side lanes. Firms can rename stages but not remove the gate stages

fields.name: lost_reason
fields.note: Chose another firm | price | no response | not a fit | timing

fields.name: filters
fields.note: needs attention (new and untouched, sequence error, SLA breach, stalled over N days), first-touch source, value band, my leads only (default)

actions.name: Move card
actions.note: Moves into gate stages (Accepted, Conflict cleared, Retain decided) only happen through the gate action, not by dragging

actions.name: Auto-advance
actions.note: Moves the card when evidence lands: a consult booked or held, the engagement letter sent or signed

actions.name: Mark lost
actions.note: If the lead was accepted, a lawyer approves the closing non-engagement letter

actions.name: Edit stages
actions.note: Admin only

actions.name: Hire
actions.note: Card quick action; opens G1 accept

actions.name: Not hired
actions.note: lost_reason required

screens.agent: Moves cards on evidence. Flags leads stuck past a stage SLA. Drafts and sends follow-up nudges from approved templates within the consent scope. Puts a limitation-at-risk lead at the top of its column.
screens.gate: none on the board itself (gate stages are entered only through G1, G2 and G3)
edge: Someone drags a card into a gate column: rejected with a link to the gate action
Lead converted by a different lawyer than the assignee: originating and responsible lawyer are recorded separately
Two pipelines claim the same lead after reclassification: the lead moves pipelines and keeps its history
screens.reg: Follow-up emails to prospects: CASL implied consent from the inquiry is time-limited (verify the 6-month inquiry rule). Do not send marketing after an opt-out.

screens.name: Consultation scheduler
screens.purpose: Books, reminds and runs consultations, with an optional consult fee.
screens.layout: Staff view: a calendar of lawyer availability with consult slots and a list of upcoming consults with their pre-consult brief status. Prospect view: pick the consult type, lawyer (optional) and slot, then confirm and pay if there is a fee.

fields.name: consult_type
fields.note: free 15 min | paid 60 min | follow-up, configured by the firm

fields.name: mode
fields.note: in person | video | phone

fields.name: start
fields.note: Firm time zone (America/Toronto)

fields.name: consult_fee
fields.note: Plus HST

fields.name: fee_status
fields.note: none | pending | paid | refunded | waived

fields.name: video_link
fields.note: Generated

fields.name: reminders
fields.note: Default 24h and 1h before

actions.name: Propose slots
actions.note: Uses lawyer availability, urgency and the limitation flag. Critical leads get the earliest slots

actions.name: Book
actions.note: Staff or the prospect. Allowed only after G1 and once the pre-conflict screen is not a 'hit'

actions.name: Reschedule / cancel
actions.note: Cancelling a paid consult triggers a refund decision

actions.name: Waive or refund fee
actions.note: Lawyer or admin

actions.name: Send reminders
actions.note: Only from a template approved under G-SK and on its approved cadence; any other text needs staff approval. Respects 'ok to leave message'

screens.agent: Proposes and holds slots, sends confirmations and reminders, and collects any missing documents before the consult. Writes a pre-consult brief for the lawyer: facts, parties, timeline, limitation analysis, open questions, and a checklist for the consult.
screens.gate: Only a fee waiver or refund needs approval. Booking itself is unblocked once G1 (and the pre-conflict screen) allow it.
edge: Prospect books then the formal conflict check (G2) finds a conflict: the agent cancels with a neutral message, refunds the fee, and a lawyer approves the letter
No-show: the agent sends one rebooking offer and moves the lead to Lost after the firm's policy period
Time zone mismatch for a prospect outside Ontario: show both time zones
Prospect pays by card: the fee goes to the operating account if it is earned at the consult, or to trust if it is paid in advance for future work (verify the firm policy and BL9 treatment)
screens.reg: A consult fee paid before the service is money received in advance of services and may need to go to trust under By-Law 9 (verify). Card processing fees must never be drawn from trust (verify). HST applies to consult fees. Identity: no ID verification is needed until funds move or the matter opens (By-Law 7.1) (verify the exemption for a fee paid by card from the client).

screens.name: Consultation outcome
screens.purpose: Records what happened at the consult and the lawyer's retain, decline or refer decision.
screens.layout: Left: the agent-drafted consult note, built from the lawyer's dictation or notes. Right: a decision panel (retain, decline, refer, follow-up needed), scope summary, proposed fee arrangement, and the documents generated next (engagement letter draft or non-engagement letter).

fields.name: consult_note
fields.note: Facts confirmed, advice given at the consult, and next steps. Stored in the matter or lead file, never in platform logs

fields.name: decision
fields.note: retain | decline | refer | follow-up

fields.name: scope
fields.note: Required if retaining. Mark full or limited scope

fields.name: fee_arrangement
fields.note: hourly | flat | contingency | blended

fields.name: limitation_confirmed
fields.note: The lawyer confirms or corrects the agent's limitation estimate. It then feeds the matter deadlines

fields.name: advice_given_summary
fields.note: Important if declining after advice was given

actions.name: Approve outcome (G3)
actions.note: Lawyer signs off on the note and the decision

actions.name: Generate engagement letter draft
actions.note: Handed to the engagement area (G5)

actions.name: Generate non-engagement letter
actions.note: States what was and was not done and mentions limitation risk

screens.agent: Turns rough notes or dictation into a structured note. Proposes scope and fee from the firm's fee schedule. Pre-fills the engagement letter or non-engagement letter. Pushes the confirmed limitation date to the deadlines calendar once the matter opens.
screens.gate: G3: a lawyer signs off on the outcome and the confirmed limitation date. On decline or refer, the lawyer also approves the letter.
edge: Lawyer gave substantive advice at a free consult and then declines: the letter must record that advice was limited to the consult and that no ongoing retainer exists
Limited-scope retainer chosen: flag that the RPC 3.2-1A requirements apply to the engagement letter
Contingency fee chosen: flag that the contingency agreement rules apply (verify the current regulation)
screens.reg: Limited-scope retainer (RPC 3.2-1A) (verify). Contingency fees fall under the Solicitors Act and its contingency fee regulation (verify current O. Reg.). Non-engagement letter practice follows LawPRO (verify).

rows: Retain: wrongful dismissal claim against Northgate Logistics Inc.
Full scope: demand letter, negotiation, claim if needed
Contingency 25% or hourly at $350. Client to choose
Confirmed 2028-08-29 (basic period), with a diary note 6 months earlier

screens.name: Convert lead to client and matter
screens.purpose: Turns a retained lead into a Client contact and an open Matter once every pre-opening gate has cleared.
screens.layout: A stepper with a checklist: G1 accepted, G2 conflict cleared, G3 retain decided, G4 ID verified, G5 engagement signed, and an optional G6 retainer in trust. Each step shows its status and a link. The bottom holds a preview of the new matter (number, name, responsible and originating lawyer, practice area, key deadlines).

fields.name: client_type
fields.note: individual | organization

fields.name: matter_name
fields.note: Agent proposes, for example 'Haile v. Northgate Logistics (wrongful dismissal)'

fields.name: matter_number
fields.note: Generated from the firm's pattern

fields.name: parties
fields.note: Copied from the lead, and these feed the conflict database

fields.name: initial_deadlines
fields.note: Includes the confirmed limitation date

fields.name: documents_to_carry
fields.note: Quarantined lead files are released into the matter

actions.name: Open matter
actions.note: Allowed only when G2 and G3 are done. G4 and G5 can be set to 'required before open' or 'before first funds' by firm policy

actions.name: Create portal invite
actions.note: Hands off to the client portal area

screens.agent: Assembles the matter record from the lead, consult outcome and engagement data. Carries the parties into the conflict index. Creates the limitation deadline with reminders. Proposes the initial task list from the practice-area template.
screens.gate: A lawyer approves opening the matter. This is blocked until G2 (conflict cleared) and G3 (retain decided) are done, and until G4 and G5 if the firm policy says so.
edge: Contact already exists as a client of another matter: link it, do not duplicate
Organization client: needs the authorized signatory and the beneficial-ownership info for ID (By-Law 7.1) (verify)
The engagement letter is signed but the retainer has not arrived: the matter can open while billing stays blocked until G6
A conversion is undone within 24 hours: archive the matter, with the audit trail kept
screens.reg: By-Law 7.1 client identification and verification (verify the triggers). RPC 3.4 conflicts must be cleared before acting. Retainer funds go to trust under By-Law 9.

screens.name: Intake dashboard
screens.purpose: Shows how well the firm turns inquiries into clients and where leads leak.
screens.layout: A KPI row (new leads, median first response, consult booking rate, conversion rate, value retained). Below it: a funnel by stage, a sources table, time-to-respond by urgency, at-risk limitation leads, and an agent triage accuracy panel (human overrides).

fields.name: period
fields.note: 7d | 30d | quarter | custom

fields.name: accept_rate
fields.note: Leads converted / leads received

fields.name: chart_type
fields.note: bar, line, pie

actions.name: Ask a question
actions.note: For example, 'which sources converted best for employment this quarter?' The agent answers with the query behind it

actions.name: Weekly intake digest
actions.note: Internal only

actions.name: Export CSV
actions.note: Aggregates only. No story text

screens.agent: Computes the metrics and writes a weekly digest (leaks, SLA breaches, leads at limitation risk, sources trending up or down). Tracks its own classification and urgency accuracy against human overrides.
edge: Small numbers: show counts, not percentages, below n=10
Referral-source ROI depends on tagging: show the untagged share
Declined leads count in the funnel but their contents are not shown
screens.reg: Dashboards show aggregates only. Prospect confidential information is not exposed beyond authorized roles.

screens.name: Intake settings
screens.purpose: One place for the lists and rules every intake screen uses: sources, practice areas, stages, service area, scoring and alerts.
screens.layout: Left: section list (Sources, Practice areas, Stages, Service area, Scoring, Notifications, Channels, Connections). Right: editable list for the chosen section with usage counts.

fields.name: lead_sources
fields.note: Name, kind (web, phone, referral person, directory, ad, AI receptionist), active flag; used by reports

fields.name: practice_areas
fields.note: Name, default lawyer, default consult type, accept/decline policy text

fields.name: stages

fields.name: service_area

fields.name: scoring_rules

fields.name: decline_reasons
fields.note: Controlled list so lost-reason reports are clean

fields.name: notifications
fields.note: Per user: new lead, lead assigned, SLA breach, booking, payment failed; channel email or in-app

fields.name: sms_enabled
fields.note: Firm-level switch; needs a verified firm number and CASL wording

fields.name: lead_capture_key
fields.note: Per-source key for external web forms and directories; shown once, rotatable, never logged

fields.name: default_assignee_rule
fields.note: round robin | by practice area | fixed person

fields.name: campaigns
fields.note: Named campaigns under a source (for example a community radio spot), with optional spend by month (manual or CSV)

actions.name: Rotate lead capture key
actions.note: Admin only; old key keeps working 24h

actions.name: Suggest scoring weights
actions.note: From the last 12 months of accepted vs lost leads; human applies

actions.name: Apply scoring change
actions.note: Admin; change is versioned so old scores stay explainable

screens.agent: Spots unused or duplicate sources ('Google' vs 'google ads') and offers a merge; proposes scoring weights from outcomes.
screens.gate: Scoring and key rotation changes need an admin; no client-facing effect so no lawyer gate.
edge: A stage is deleted while leads sit in it: must pick a target stage first
A source is retired but old leads keep it for reports
Scoring change mid-week makes the dashboard mix old and new scores: show score version
screens.reg: Scoring must not use protected grounds under the Ontario Human Rights Code (verify).

screens.name: Intake follow-up sequences
screens.purpose: Build the automatic steps that run after a lead arrives: acknowledge, send questionnaire, offer booking, remind, move stage.
screens.layout: Top: trigger and filters. Middle: ordered step list with wait times and stop conditions. Right: preview of each outgoing message and a dry-run log.

fields.name: trigger
fields.note: lead created | stage entered | form submitted | consult booked | engagement unsigned N days

fields.name: filters
fields.note: Practice area, source, score band, language

fields.name: steps
fields.note: send email | send SMS | send questionnaire | send booking link | create task | move stage | wait

fields.name: stop_conditions
fields.note: Lead replied, booked, declined, retained, opted out; always includes opt-out

fields.name: quiet_hours
fields.note: No SMS outside 8am-9pm prospect local time

fields.name: status

screens.agent: Runs the call or chat, never gives legal advice, never states fees beyond the published consult fee, writes lead with transcript and fit score.

edge: Caller is an existing client: route to their lawyer, do not create a lead
Caller names an opposing party of a current client: stop collecting facts, take contact only
Caller is a minor or in crisis: emergency rule, human callback
Poor audio: agent says so and offers a callback, never guesses a name
Caller refuses recording: continue without recording, notes only
Email from a lawyer referring a client: routed to for_review, never auto-answered
FAQ answer edited but not yet approved: the agent keeps using the last approved answer
screens.reg: Avoid creating a solicitor-client relationship or giving advice (LSO Rules ch. 3, verify). Disclose automation; recording consent under PIPEDA (verify).

open_questions: Should the agent ever show the prospect a limitation warning on the public form (for example, 'some claims have short deadlines, contact us urgently'), or is that too close to advice?
Is the limitation flag allowed to auto-promote a lead to 'critical' and page the on-call lawyer outside business hours?
Consult fees: always deposit them to trust first, or let the firm choose to treat a same-day consult fee as earned in operating?
Which practice areas and short notice periods ship in v1 (for example municipal road notice, Crown notice, accident benefits, HRTO 1-year, ESA complaints)? All need verification against statute.
Do we record phone intake calls at all in v1, or only staff notes?
Should G4 (ID) and G5 (engagement signed) be hard prerequisites to open a matter, or firm-configurable as drafted?
Is a French-language public form required in v1?
Is LSO Referral Service integration in scope, or just a source tag?
How long are declined-lead records retained? They are needed for future conflict checks, but they must meet PIPEDA's limits on retention
Do we run our own AI phone line in v1, or only web chat plus phone notes?
Should paid consults hold the slot for 10 minutes or longer?

Email marketing campaigns (segments, consent basis per recipient, unsubscribe, metrics): in scope at all? Needs an owner decision against LSO Rule 4.2 (marketing) and CASL (express or implied consent, expiry, unsubscribe) before any screen is specced.

Review requests after matter close (reputation dashboard): in scope at all? Needs an owner decision against LSO Rule 4.2 on testimonials and CASL; if yes, off by default, no incentives, ask everyone or no one.
Agent activity panel plus a monthly cap on agent-handled conversations with an 80% alert? (could)
Quick Form: staff fill a questionnaire live on the phone, saved with taken_by? (could)
Self-serve refresh of an expired questionnaire link within N days (default 30)? (could)
Cap appointment reminders at 5 with firm defaults and auto-created video links? (could)
Optional analytics hook on the public form and chat (no PII, off by default)? (could)
Should our receptionist ever reply by email without a human beyond fact collection and booking (Clio does)?
